title: Biologic therapy infusion
what: A special medicine that targets one part of the immune system is given through a drip into a vein. The infusion is repeated at set intervals.
why: For rheumatoid arthritis, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, psoriasis, and other immune diseases.
duration: the infusion usually takes 1 to 3 hours including observation; it is repeated every few weeks, on a schedule
tell_doctor: A fever, cough, or any infection right now
Tuberculosis or contact with it, and hepatitis

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Before starting, tuberculosis, hepatitis, and blood tests are usually checked.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop your usual medicines on your own.

prepare.title: Time
prepare.text: Bring water, a snack, and something to do for a few hours.

steps: A nurse measures your blood pressure, pulse, and temperature
A line is placed in a vein
Sometimes anti-allergy medicine is given first
The drip is connected, and the speed is raised gradually
The nurse watches how you feel
After the drip, you stay a little while under observation
feel: The drip itself usually does not hurt
Sometimes a headache or tiredness on the infusion day
Heat, itching, or a rash during the infusion: tell the nurse right away
after: You can usually go back to your normal activities right away
Wash your hands and avoid contact with sick people
Live vaccines only after checking with your doctor
Come for the next infusion on time
red_flags: Shortness of breath, swollen face, or a rash: call emergency services
A fever of 38°C (100.4°F) or higher, or a cough: call your doctor
Any infection: tell your doctor before the next infusion

faq.q: Why do they check for tuberculosis?
faq.a: The medicine lowers part of your defenses. A hidden infection can wake up, so it is looked for beforehand.
It is better not to. If you are sick or something gets in the way, call your doctor, who will decide.

reminders.text: Biologic therapy infusion tomorrow. If you have a fever or an infection, call the clinic before the visit.
